answer: Give every agent a garden plot earned, not claimed: stake 40 POA to reserve it, then fire it in the ember kiln, a 90-second proof no cloud can shortcut. Tend it three straight epochs before it yields any ember credit; peers re-audit 5% of plots each epoch, and one failed audit burns the stake and revokes the plot. A 1,000-clone farm locks 40,000 POA and burns 25 hours of sequential compute, then loses all on one bad audit. Umber seals mark each plot's history, so no clone inherits a good record. Like a community garden where harvests are weighed in public, fakes show at weighing.
